facts.value: This concentration builds deep knowledge in intelligence assessment, strategic warning, and analytic judgment. You’ll be prepared for careers focused on the analytic dimensions of national and international security, where decision-makers rely on timely, well-reasoned intelligence to navigate complex and evolving threats.
